746770101.text: Haha! What luck that two fine-looking adventurers such as yourselves have run into me, Costentin, here today. It must be fate...

746770102.text: So tell me, the pair of you — do you wish to revel in glorious combat?

746770103.text: Talk about out of the blue! Do you usually start conversations like this?

746770106.text: No no, I'm not challenging you two to a fight...

746770107.text: By "combat," I don't mean some frivolous venting of pent-up anger, nor some kind of highway robbery.

746770108.text: I'm talking about an ode to your inner passion, an artistic appreciation of the expression of your natural instincts!

746770109.text: Evolution has given us hands with which to grip our swords, so it's our duty to use them for their purpose: clenching a blade most beautiful and wielding it in an elegant dance of death!

746770110.text: As a pair of intrepid adventurers, I have no doubt that you'll be masters of this art!

746770111.text: Uhh, you seem to be grasping the wrong end of the stick when it comes to combat... you're making it sound like the best thing since sliced bread!

746770112.text: #Even though Paimon doesn't usually get involved, just seeing how {NICKNAME} deals with enemies is enough for her to know that fighting's really tough!

746770113.text: That's another thing, we haven't even told you who we are! How can you be so sure we're good at fighting?

746770114.text: Well, we're already quite some distance from the Court of Fontaine. How else could you have gotten here, if not by slaughtering every monster obstructing your path? By dropping out of the sky?
